facts.business: The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of soft ferrite cores used in applications such as inverter transformers, EV chargers, energy meters, mobile chargers, SMPS, pulse transformers, line filters, chokes, and noise suppressors.
key_risks: Geopolitical conflicts introducing volatility in supply of key raw materials and logistics networks
Fluctuations in energy prices and freight costs adversely impacting operating margins
Uncertainties in global trade environments including sanctions, currency volatility, and regional economic slowdowns affecting export demand and pricing competitiveness
Rapid technological advancements risking obsolescence and loss of market share for companies unable to continuously innovate and upgrade manufacturing processes and product capabilities
